description:
## [1.1.0](https://github.com/TgSeed/Morpheeeps/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0) (2026-11-15)

### ✨ New Features

* **symfonium:** add patch disabling the randomised beta-expiry tripwire ([d2f800d](https://github.com/TgSeed/Morpheeeps/commit/d2f800d726df18bf6124cdc6a7956f480981c52e))

patches.name: Disable Crashlytics
patches.description: Makes the Crashlytics Firebase registrar report no components, so the SDK is never instantiated and its crash handler is never installed.

patches.name: Disable Firebase Analytics
patches.description: Makes every void method of FirebaseAnalytics return immediately, so no analytics event is recorded or uploaded. Getters and getInstance() are untouched.

patches.name: Disable LeakCanary
patches.description: Stops the bundled LeakCanary memory profiler from installing itself by making its ContentProvider onCreate() return false.

patches.name: Disable Matomo analytics
patches.description: Rewrites the Matomo collector URL so every analytics beacon targets an unroutable host. The Tracker is still constructed; nothing is ever delivered.

patches.name: Disable beta expiry tripwire
patches.description: Stops the app from randomly replacing the requested screen with the "beta version has expired" update wall.

patches.name: Force licensed state
patches.description: Makes the licence verdict always positive and rewrites stored trial/locked entitlement values to the purchased value, so premium features stay unlocked.

patches.name: Force purchased state
patches.description: Reports a purchased licence by forcing the purchase state to its success value wherever the app sets an error or not-started state.

patches.name: Hide trial card
patches.description: Stops the licence screen from showing the free-trial expiry card and its purchase button by never storing the trial end date the server reports.

patches.name: Remove third-party QR code service
patches.description: Points the share-as-QR image URL at a local placeholder so shared content is never sent to api.qrserver.com.
